core_obligations: Set-up: choose the structural morphism that makes the stack a gerbe over an algebraic space and observe that it suffices to show that space is the sheafification of the displayed presheaf, for which the canonical comparison map exists (proof lines 6101-6107)

Surjectivity: an arbitrary morphism from a scheme to the space is, by the first gerbe clause, locally on an fppf cover the image of a morphism from that piece into the stack, hence locally in the image of the comparison map (proof lines 6108-6114)

Injectivity: two morphisms into the stack with the same image in the space are, by the second gerbe clause, locally isomorphic after an fppf cover, so they define the same section of the sheafification (proof lines 6115-6125)
Conclusion: a surjective and injective map of sheaves is an isomorphism (proof lines 6114-6116)
proof_roadmap: 取把 X 变成 X 上 gerbe 的 π；只要证 X 是所述预层的层化。
满射：任给 T → X，由 gerbe 条件 (2)(a) 有 fppf 覆盖 T_i → T 与 x_i: T_i → X 使 f∘h_i 与 π∘x_i 对应。
单射：x, y 在 X 上像同 ⇒ 由 (2)(b) 局部有同构 ⇒ 在层化里给同一截面。
由「单 + 满 ⇒ 同构」的层论判据收尾。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a gerbe over an algebraic space, that space is the sheafification of the presheaf of isomorphism classes of objects of the gerbe (author lemma at source lines 6090-6099, label lemma-gerbe-over-iso-classes). The proof (source lines 6101-6126) compares the two sheaves, proves surjectivity from the local existence of objects and injectivity from the local existence of isomorphisms supplied by the two clauses of the gerbe condition, and concludes by the injective-plus-surjective criterion for morphisms of sheaves (proof lines 6101-6125). The verification of the two sheaf-theoretic clauses from the gerbe condition is the content. H3.
